brief: Transform, add or select values from incoming, structured data, based on a fixed routine or depending on the input values
configuration: A template controls how the incoming data is processed.

configuration.description: Add or replace an existing <key> with a constant value
Add or replace an existing <key> with a computed value. The structured input data is available in <params>.

inputs: Typically use this service with structured JSON coming into the service
outputs: In case the input data type is non-structured data, the incoming data is returned as-is as output.
Otherwise the processed structured data is returned as an object.
